svg.aria-label: One transaction, step by step. Your app builds a transaction, the wallet signs it, and your app sends it to the network through RPC. The network verifies the signatures and charges the fee, then runs your program's instruction all or nothing: your program derives a PDA, reads state, calls the Token Program through a CPI that the PDA signs, and writes state. Your app then gets the confirmation.
svg.text: Charge the fee to the fee payer. It is
charged even if the transaction fails.
